title: The Continuous Tenses
description: Learn the present continuous and past continuous for Grade 6: form (be + -ing), uses, the spelling of -ing, and signal words — with bilingual notes, practice and tests.

topics.title: Present Continuous & the Spelling of -ing
topics.concept:
The present continuous uses is/am/are + V-ing. Use it for:

  • Actions happening right now: She is reading a book.
  • Temporary actions around now: He is staying with us this week.
  • Fixed future plans: We are leaving tomorrow.

Spelling the -ing form:

  • Most verbs just add -ing: play → playing.
  • Drop a final silent -e: write → writing, make → making.
  • Double the final consonant after a short vowel: run → running, sit → sitting.

Signal words: now, at the moment, look!, listen!, currently, these days.

examples.solution: sitting — short vowel + single consonant, so double the 't'.

recap: Used for actions happening now / temporary / fixed plans
Spelling: add -ing, drop -e, or double the consonant

topics.title: Past Continuous Tense
topics.concept:
The past continuous uses was/were + V-ing. Use it for:

  • An action in progress at a past moment: At 8 p.m. I was studying.
  • A longer action interrupted by a shorter one: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
  • Two actions happening together: She was singing while he was playing.

Use was with I/he/she/it and were with you/we/they. The interrupting short action is usually in the simple past (rang, came).

examples.problem: Complete: They ___ (play) when it started to rain.
examples.solution: were playing — a longer past action in progress; 'they' takes 'were'.

recap: Shows an action in progress in the past

questions.explanation: Present continuous for a fixed future plan.

questions.q: Spot the error: 'When the teacher entered, the students were making noise and one boy throws a paper.'
questions.explanation: The sequence needs a past form: 'threw' (or 'was throwing').

questions.q: Choose: 'I ___ my dinner when the power ___.'
questions.explanation: Ongoing action = past continuous 'was having'; interruption = simple past 'went'.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'She is belonging to a musical family.'
questions.explanation: 'belong' is a state verb; use the simple present.

questions.q: Fill in: 'While we ___ for the bus, it ___ to rain.'
questions.explanation: Background action = past continuous; sudden start = simple past 'began'.

options: They were play in the garden.
They were playing in the garden.
They was playing in the garden.
They are play in the garden.

questions.explanation: 'Listen!' signals an action happening now → present continuous.

questions.q: Rearrange: 'was / when / arrived / she / cooking / I'
options: She was cooking when I arrived.
She cooking was when I arrived.
When I arrived she cooking was.
She was cook when I arrived.
questions.explanation: 'She was cooking when I arrived.' is correct.

questions.q: Pick the correct option: 'These days, prices ___ steadily.'
questions.explanation: 'These days' signals a temporary trend → present continuous 'are rising'.

outcomes: Form the present and past continuous (be + verb-ing)
Use the present continuous for actions happening now
Use the past continuous for actions in progress in the past
Tell continuous tenses apart from simple tenses

intro.en: The continuous tenses show an action in progress — happening and not yet finished. The form is a part of the verb be + the -ing form. "She is reading" (now) and "She was reading" (at a past moment) both show an ongoing action.
intro.hi: Continuous Tenses ऐसी क्रिया दिखाते हैं जो चल रही है — हो रही है और अभी समाप्त नहीं हुई। रूप होता है be का रूप + क्रिया का -ing रूप। "She is reading" (अभी) और "She was reading" (बीते किसी क्षण) दोनों जारी क्रिया दिखाते हैं।

real_life.situation:
You call a friend:

You: What are you doing?

Friend: I am cooking dinner. When you called, I was washing the vegetables.
real_life.why: am cooking = happening right now (present continuous); was washing = was in progress at a past moment (past continuous). The -ing tells us the action was still rolling.

rule_box.html:
TenseFormExample
Present Continuousis/am/are + V-ingShe is writing.
Past Continuouswas/were + V-ingShe was writing.
rule_box.example: They are playing now; they were playing when it rained.

quick_test.q: The continuous tense always uses a form of:
quick_test.explanation: Continuous tenses use a form of 'be' (is/am/are/was/were) + V-ing.

common_mistakes.note: Double the final consonant after a short vowel.
Verbs of state (know, like) are not used in the continuous.

fill_l2.instructions: Complete with the present or past continuous.

error_detection.correct: She is writing a letter now.

sentence_correction.correct: He is sitting on the chair.

rearrangement.jumbled: were / when / playing / we / it / rained
rearrangement.answer: We were playing when it rained.

reading.passage: It was a busy evening at home. Mother was cooking in the kitchen while Father was reading the newspaper. The children were doing their homework. Suddenly the doorbell rang. "Someone is knocking," said Riya, and she ran to open the door.

questions.q: Find two actions happening at the same time in the past.
questions.answer: Mother was cooking while Father was reading — both past continuous.

questions.q: Which action interrupted the others, and what tense is it?
questions.answer: The doorbell rang — simple past, interrupting the ongoing actions.
is knocking — 'Someone is knocking' shows an action happening now.

speaking: I am reading an interesting book.
She was singing when I arrived.
We are leaving for Delhi tomorrow.
They were watching a film at 9 p.m.

writing.prompt: Write five sentences about what people are doing in your home right now, using the present continuous.
writing.example: My mother is cooking. My brother is studying. The dog is sleeping near the door.

micro_quiz.q: Which verb is NOT used in the continuous?
micro_quiz.explanation: 'know' is a state verb, not used in the continuous.
'Look!' signals an action happening now → present continuous.

options: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
While I cook, the phone was ringing.
While I cooking, the phone rang.
While I was cook, the phone rang.
challenge.explanation: Longer action = past continuous; interrupting action = simple past.

challenge.q: Identify the error: 'I am understanding the lesson now.'
challenge.explanation: 'understand' is a state verb; use the simple present.

challenge.q: Which sentence shows a fixed future plan?
options: We are flying to Goa next Monday.
challenge.explanation: The present continuous can show a fixed future arrangement.

  +ing/drop-e/double   was=I/he, were=we
revision: Past continuous (was/were) → in progress in the past
-ing spelling: add -ing, drop -e, or double the consonant
